diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says SIG, datasheet reading says VIN
diffs.evidence: Adafruit's own Eagle board file for this product (5913) puts the 0.1in header JP1 pad 1 on the signal net: '<signal name="SIGNAL"> <contactref element="JP1" pad="1"/>', and the Learn pinouts page names that pin 'SIG - this is the output signal from the TCRT1000'; the second reading's VIN/GND/OUT order was a guess.

diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says VIN, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: Adafruit's Eagle board file puts header JP1 pad 2 on the VIN net: '<signal name="VIN"> <contactref element="C1" pad="1"/> <contactref element="JP1" pad="2"/>'.

diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says GND, datasheet reading says OUT
diffs.evidence: Adafruit's Eagle board file puts header JP1 pad 3 on the GND net: '<signal name="GND"> <contactref element="C1" pad="2"/> <contactref element="JP1" pad="3"/>' (the output is on pad 1, the SIGNAL net).
